name: Automatic HTTP capacity, lazy slot growth and bounded joint groups
default: AUTO capacity; at most 4 eager slots; 65536 queued requests; 4096 connections
exact: Contract: complete greedy IDs and prompt/final committed state match explicit single at the same profile and frontier. CPU growth-policy/controller tests and Release compile checks only; GPU lazy-growth capacity matrix pending.
preconditions: Valid tiled MTP serving assets; prefix windows, draft chain and rows 2,4,8; no single-only feature. Measured stack delta plus future native budgets and active peaks, MemAvailable/GTT and headroom admit extra slots. Queued work with every built slot active appends one slot per engine-loop iteration outside steps and service parks, using the eager factories. Fresh memory observations with headroom can stop growth below capacity; shutdown receipts record built/capacity, lazy build counts/timings and memory decline. Joint groups and draft microbatches retain widths at most eight.
off_switch: --http-batch 0 selects the single route; positive N caps capacity with the same eager limit. STRIX_HTTP_EAGER_SLOTS=0 builds all slots eagerly. Incompatible AUTO falls back with a reason; incompatible explicit caps fail. Explicit small staging limits retain 429/503 behavior.

name: In-block decode service, short-first, nested admission and cancellation points
exact: Generated token IDs and committed target state of every request bitwise equal to the request alone, with service at every layer, nesting and cancel-then-reuse (GPU gates); only MTP predictor rows follow draft batching, as before.
gain: 3 decoding streams + 32K prompt + 2 short arrivals, default command: decode gap p90 during the 32K prefill 14.3 s -> 0.54 s, short first token 42-52 s -> 2.3-3.8 s, 32K first token 53.1 -> 63.5 s; worst gap left = one on-demand slot build (5.6 s); with 6 slots built at startup worst gap 12.3 s -> 2.8 s.
preconditions: Batched tiled MTP route. Nesting: T8192 with the 1024/256/64/16 tails and dense-A8 prefill; groups finish their unit before cancelling.
off_switch: Each knob 0; all of service, cancel points and nesting 0 = previous synchronous path.

name: Automatic tiled prefill, expert union and router rows
exact: Tokens and terminal FP32 logits digests match the reference for the selected profile pair, including 32K/64K/128K/262K. Fast FP16 prefill is exact relative to its own reference, not bit-identical to dense-A8 serial prefill; longer-context fidelity remains outside the 8192 qualification.
gain: One Strix Halo node: 32K 22.03 s = 1,487 tok/s; 131,072 tokens 100.3 s; 262,143 tokens 202.8 s = 1,293 tok/s. Previous documented default externally reported about 119 tok/s versus about 822 with union + router rows; separate from local measurements.
preconditions: Pinned verified checkpoint, qualified gfx1151 target, A8 runtime, >=16 prompt tokens, positive generation, eligible eager registered mapping, unambiguous UMA/GTT observations and sufficient backing capacity.
off_switch: --baseline / STRIX_BASELINE=1 restores historical resolution; STRIX_PREFILL_F16=0 or --known-prefix-window=0 declines automatic tiling. --prefill-numerical-profile dense-a8 retains tiling with dense-A8 arithmetic. Controlled feature =0 or STRIX_QPF2K_DEFAULTS=0 also declines auto selection; exact operator A/B needs an explicit route with the same profile pair.

Exactly one file-backed IQ4_NL/BF16 n-gram table, valid extents and unregistered interior pages, valid prompt hashes, and a verified page drop within the existing residual bound.

name: QPF2K_QSA
exact: The qualification campaign compared 1K code and 8K prose receipts, terminal FP32 logits FNV and generated tokens against the unchanged reference. Repeat with the same prefill/decode identity; changing arithmetic profiles is a separate quality comparison. Stage-batching qualification additionally compared terminal logits and 1K code/8K prose receipts.
gain: Stage batching: 32K mean -0.39 s (-1.7%); published-build ABBA -0.17 s; 64K -1.6%
preconditions: Stage batching requires mask bits 0x3 as well as 0x200; normal eager prefill, 1..128 complete 64-row groups with no partial tiles, grouped norm enabled, BF16 KV and pooled-key storage. Index geometry is four heads of dimension 128, 16-byte aligned queries and prefixes bounded by pool capacity and 65536 blocks. The norm tensors share a weight format, have power-of-two dimensions 2..256, and admit the rotary geometry (half rotary dimension <=64). Rows need contiguous positions and common raw/KV owners, geometry, norm owners, journal, compression ratio and top-k. Private device tables/maxima and pinned descriptors must allocate before any launch/state write. Windows, cohorts, graphs, int8 KV, explicit tiled diagnostics and self-check modes keep their existing paths.
